requetes.volumes_gold: SELECT 'client_unique' AS table_cible, COUNT(*) n FROM gold.client_unique WHERE _batch_id=:lot UNION ALL SELECT 'xref_identifiants',COUNT(*) FROM gold.xref_identifiants x JOIN gold.client_unique u USING(cli_id) WHERE u._batch_id=:lot UNION ALL SELECT 'contrat_certifie',COUNT(*) FROM gold.contrat_certifie WHERE _batch_id=:lot UNION ALL SELECT 'sinistre_certifie',COUNT(*) FROM gold.sinistre_certifie WHERE _batch_id=:lot
requetes.historique: SELECT h.couche,h.rule_id,h.table_cible,h.nb_testees,h.nb_echecs,h.taux_conformite,r.severite,r.seuil_min FROM dq.dq_history h JOIN dq.regle r USING(rule_id) WHERE h.batch_id=:lot AND h.couche IN ('SILVER','GOLD') ORDER BY 1,2,3
requetes.lineage_clients: SELECT s.source_systeme,COUNT(*) testees,SUM(x.silver_row_id IS NULL OR u.cli_id IS NULL) lien_gold_manquant,SUM((s.source_systeme='crm' AND bc.bronze_row_id IS NULL) OR (s.source_systeme='cif' AND bf.bronze_row_id IS NULL)) lien_bronze_manquant FROM silver.client s LEFT JOIN gold.xref_identifiants x ON x.silver_row_id=s.silver_row_id AND x.bronze_row_id=s.bronze_row_id AND x.source_systeme=s.source_systeme AND x.source_id=s.source_id LEFT JOIN gold.client_unique u ON u.cli_id=x.cli_id AND u._batch_id=s._batch_id LEFT JOIN bronze.crm_client bc ON s.source_systeme='crm' AND bc.bronze_row_id=s.bronze_row_id AND bc._batch_id=s._batch_id AND bc.client_id=s.source_id LEFT JOIN bronze.cif_clients bf ON s.source_systeme='cif' AND bf.bronze_row_id=s.bronze_row_id AND bf._batch_id=s._batch_id AND bf.column0=s.source_id WHERE s._batch_id=:lot GROUP BY s.source_systeme
requetes.lineage_contrats: SELECT COUNT(*) testees,SUM(s.silver_row_id IS NULL OR b.bronze_row_id IS NULL) liens_manquants FROM gold.contrat_certifie g LEFT JOIN silver.contrat s ON s.silver_row_id=g.silver_row_id AND s.bronze_row_id=g.bronze_row_id AND s._batch_id=g._batch_id LEFT JOIN bronze.crm_contrat b ON b.bronze_row_id=g.bronze_row_id AND b._batch_id=g._batch_id AND b.contrat_id=g.contrat_id WHERE g._batch_id=:lot
requetes.lineage_sinistres: SELECT COUNT(*) testees,SUM(s.silver_row_id IS NULL OR b.bronze_row_id IS NULL) liens_manquants FROM gold.sinistre_certifie g LEFT JOIN silver.sinistre s ON s.silver_row_id=g.silver_row_id AND s.bronze_row_id=g.bronze_row_id AND s._batch_id=g._batch_id LEFT JOIN bronze.crm_sinistre b ON b.bronze_row_id=g.bronze_row_id AND b._batch_id=g._batch_id AND b.sinistre_id=g.sinistre_id WHERE g._batch_id=:lot
requetes.doublons_xref: SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM (SELECT x.source_systeme,x.source_id FROM gold.xref_identifiants x JOIN gold.client_unique u USING(cli_id) WHERE u._batch_id=:lot GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT x.cli_id)>1) d
requetes.orphelins: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gold.contrat_certifie c LEFT JOIN gold.client_unique u ON u.cli_id=c.cli_souscripteur AND u._batch_id=c._batch_id WHERE c._batch_id=:lot AND u.cli_id IS NULL) contrats_sans_souscripteur,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gold.contrat_certifie c LEFT JOIN gold.client_unique u ON u.cli_id=c.cli_assure AND u._batch_id=c._batch_id WHERE c._batch_id=:lot AND c.cli_assure IS NOT NULL AND u.cli_id IS NULL) assures_inconnus,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gold.sinistre_certifie s LEFT JOIN gold.contrat_certifie c ON c.contrat_id=s.contrat_id AND c._batch_id=s._batch_id WHERE s._batch_id=:lot AND c.contrat_id IS NULL) sinistres_sans_contrat
requetes.meunier: SELECT x.source_systeme,x.source_id,x.cli_id FROM gold.xref_identifiants x JOIN gold.client_unique u USING(cli_id) WHERE u._batch_id=:lot AND x.cli_id IN (SELECT cli_id FROM gold.xref_identifiants WHERE source_systeme='crm' AND source_id='A-4471') ORDER BY 1,2
requetes.cardinalite_xref: SELECT COUNT(*) anomalies FROM (SELECT s.silver_row_id FROM silver.client s LEFT JOIN gold.xref_identifiants x ON x.silver_row_id=s.silver_row_id AND x.source_systeme=s.source_systeme AND x.source_id=s.source_id AND x.bronze_row_id=s.bronze_row_id WHERE s._batch_id=:lot GROUP BY s.silver_row_id HAVING COUNT(x.cli_id)<>1) d
requetes.sources_clients: SELECT s.source_systeme,COUNT(*) testees,SUM((s.source_systeme='crm' AND c.client_id IS NULL) OR (s.source_systeme='cif' AND f.column0 IS NULL)) sources_manquantes FROM silver.client s LEFT JOIN crm.client c ON s.source_systeme='crm' AND c.client_id=s.source_id LEFT JOIN cif.clients f ON s.source_systeme='cif' AND f.column0=s.source_id WHERE s._batch_id=:lot GROUP BY 1
requetes.sources_contrats: SELECT COUNT(*) testees,SUM(c.contrat_id IS NULL) sources_manquantes FROM gold.contrat_certifie g LEFT JOIN crm.contrat c ON c.contrat_id=g.contrat_id WHERE g._batch_id=:lot
requetes.sources_sinistres: SELECT COUNT(*) testees,SUM(c.sinistre_id IS NULL) sources_manquantes FROM gold.sinistre_certifie g LEFT JOIN crm.sinistre c ON c.sinistre_id=g.sinistre_id WHERE g._batch_id=:lot
requetes.actifs: SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM gold.v_client_actif WHERE _batch_id=:lot
